reason_for_revision.rs_result: The corrected six-feature RS quality-benefit head failed both the 32-to-16 prospective check and 48-group nested OOF; it predicted all off at the frozen 0.60 threshold.
reason_for_revision.estimand_problem: A single stochastic response winner is too noisy to serve as a per-state oracle for a small V1.5 router.
reason_for_revision.v1_5_scope_decision: Train transparent component-use/applicability proxies from pre-response controlled labels; use matched response outcomes only to qualify a resource treatment and to evaluate the final policy.

research_object: A low-capacity supervised pre-retrieval gate that predicts whether MP, MS, or ME is needed in a controlled state, then passes the predicted bits through fixed risk and cost constraints before a fixed retrieval/generation stack runs.
claim_limits: This is supervised controlled resource-use routing, not individual treatment-effect estimation.
The labels are synthetic/evaluator-side intended resource requirements, not clinical need, human welfare, or latent psychological diagnosis.
A component-use head passing does not by itself prove the retrieved item improves response quality.
End-to-end quality, interaction/grounding risk, and cost remain separate evaluation outcomes.
RS is not promoted from this contract; its corrected outcome-based head is NOT_LEARNED.

data.grain: one state per controlled case; nine states per synthetic user
data.split_rule: All fitting, standardization, C selection, and feature decisions use development users only. Internal users are evaluated after this contract is frozen.
data.independence: User-grouped; nine regimes from one user never cross a fold.

model.selection: user-grouped development CV; minimum mean log-loss then one-standard-error preference for smaller C

comparators: single-feature component-query-similarity threshold selected on development only

interpretation.passes_prior_but_not_rule: The learned head recovered controlled out-of-user component-use signal but did not establish an advantage over a transparent similarity rule.
interpretation.passes_rule: The learned head recovered controlled out-of-user component-use signal and improved on the frozen single-feature rule.
interpretation.fails: Keep that component off and report NOT_LEARNED; do not tune on internal users.

next_gate_after_learning.reason: ME was the strongest V1 cost-matched comparator and directly tests memory-use/misuse risk.
next_gate_after_learning.required_before_external: A small frozen actual-retriever M0+R0 versus ME+R0 matched-pair check must show that the ME treatment is usable; this check evaluates treatment quality/risk, not per-state training labels.
next_gate_after_learning.human_work_cap: One final compact blind packet; no new RS annotation.
